zones.name: right_margin_top
zones.note: Template: right margin 60 px at 540x960 beside the top block, doubled; the block is 200 px at 540x960 tall at this width, so it ends at y=400. The in-feed AD template is also used for organic TikTok (no organic template is published).

zones.name: right_rail
zones.note: Template: right action rail 120 px wide at 540x960 below y=200, doubled. Mirrored on the Arabic (RTL) template. The in-feed AD template is also used for organic TikTok (no organic template is published).

zones.name: bottom_ui
zones.note: Template: bottom 406 px (one line of ad copy) to 507 px (four lines) at 540x960. The four-line case is used (y=906 at 1080x1920): the one-line case starts at y=1108. The in-feed AD template is also used for organic TikTok (no organic template is published).
